results.label: Single Table
results.question: show all products in Electronics category
results.sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, c.category_name 
FROM products p 
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id 
WHERE c.category_name = 'Electronics'

results.label: Single Table
results.question: list all stores in North region
results.sql: SELECT id, name, city, region, store_type FROM stores WHERE region = 'North'

results.label: Single Table
results.question: show all employees in Sales department
results.sql:
SELECT e.id, e.name, e.role, e.department_id, e.store_id, e.salary 
FROM employees e 
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id 
WHERE d.department_name = 'Sales'

results.label: Single Table
results.question: which warehouses are running low on stock
results.sql: SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(stock_qty) AS total_stock FROM inventory WHERE stock_qty <= reorder_level GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY total_stock ASC LIMIT 10

results.label: 2-3 Table Join
results.question: which customers placed the most orders
results.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(id) as total_orders FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 10

results.label: 2-3 Table Join
results.question: show total revenue by product category
results.sql:
SELECT c.category_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue 
FROM store_sales s 
JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.id 
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id 
GROUP BY c.category_name 
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

results.label: 2-3 Table Join
results.question: top 10 customers by total amount spent
results.sql: SELECT store_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_spent FROM store_sales GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10

results.label: 2-3 Table Join
results.question: which brand has the highest selling products
results.sql:
SELECT b.brand_name, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity FROM brands b 
JOIN products p ON b.id = p.brand_id 
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id 
GROUP BY b.brand_name 
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC 
LIMIT 10

results.label: 2-3 Table Join
results.question: show all orders with payment status Failed
results.sql:
SELECT orders.id, orders.customer_id, orders.order_date, orders.status, orders.channel, payments.status, payments.amount 
FROM orders 
INNER JOIN payments 
ON orders.id = payments.order_id 
WHERE payments.status = 'Failed'

results.label: 2-3 Table Join
results.question: which region has the highest number of orders
results.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(id) as total_orders FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 10
results.sql_healed: SELECT customers.region, COUNT(orders.id) as total_orders FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.region ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 10

results.label: 4-5 Table Join
results.question: show revenue by customer segment and region
results.sql:
SELECT cs.segment_name, c.region, SUM(ss.revenue) AS total_revenue 
FROM store_sales ss 
JOIN customers c ON ss.store_id = c.id 
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.segment_id = cs.id 
GROUP BY cs.segment_name, c.region 
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

results.label: 4-5 Table Join
results.question: which store sold the most Electronics products
results.sql: SELECT store_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM store_sales WHERE product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE category_id = 1) GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

results.label: 4-5 Table Join
results.question: top 5 products by revenue across all order items
results.sql:
SELECT product_id, SUM(unit_price * quantity) AS total_revenue 
FROM order_items 
GROUP BY product_id 
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC 
LIMIT 5

results.label: 4-5 Table Join
results.question: show monthly revenue trend for year 2024
results.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue 
FROM store_sales 
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) = 2024 
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date) 
ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date)

results.label: 4-5 Table Join
results.question: which customers returned the most items
results.sql:
SELECT T1.customer_id, COUNT(T2.id) AS total_returned_items 
FROM orders AS T1 
JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.order_id 
WHERE T1.status = 'Returned' 
GROUP BY T1.customer_id 
ORDER BY total_returned_items DESC 
LIMIT 10

results.label: Deep Join 6+
results.question: show total revenue by brand for completed orders only
results.sql:
SELECT p.brand_id, SUM(ss.revenue) AS total_revenue 
FROM store_sales ss 
JOIN products p ON ss.product_id = p.id 
JOIN orders o ON ss.store_id = o.id 
WHERE o.status = 'Completed' 
GROUP BY p.brand_id 
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC 
LIMIT 10

results.label: Deep Join 6+
results.question: which department employees work in the highest revenue stores
results.sql:
SELECT T1.department_id, SUM(T2.revenue) AS total_revenue 
FROM employees AS T1 
JOIN stores AS T3 ON T1.store_id = T3.id 
JOIN store_sales AS T2 ON T3.id = T2.store_id 
GROUP BY T1.department_id 
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC 
LIMIT 10

results.label: Deep Join 6+
results.question: compare online vs in-store revenue by product category
results.sql:
SELECT 
  c.category_name, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS online_revenue, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.revenue IS NOT NULL THEN ss.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS in_store_revenue
FROM 
  products p
  LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
  LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON p.id = ss.product_id
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
GROUP BY 
  c.category_name
ORDER BY 
  online_revenue + in_store_revenue DESC;
results.sql_healed:

FROM

results.label: Deep Join 6+
results.question: show top 10 customers by revenue who never returned any item
results.sql:
SELECT T1.customer_id, SUM(T2.unit_price * T2.quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM orders AS T1
JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.order_id

GROUP BY T1.customer_id
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

results.label: Deep Join 6+
results.question: which warehouse region has the lowest stock for top selling products
results.sql:
SELECT T1.region, SUM(T2.stock_qty) 
FROM warehouses AS T1 
JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.warehouse_id 
JOIN store_sales AS T3 ON T2.product_id = T3.product_id 
GROUP BY T1.region 
ORDER BY SUM(T2.stock_qty) ASC 
LIMIT 10

results.label: Aggregation
results.question: what is the average order value by channel
results.sql:
SELECT channel, AVG(T1.unit_price * T1.quantity) AS average_order_value 
FROM order_items T1 
JOIN orders T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.id 
GROUP BY T2.channel 
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC 
LIMIT 10

results.label: Aggregation
results.question: show revenue growth month over month for 2023 vs 2024
results.sql:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) AS year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date) AS month,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue,
    LAG(SUM(revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date)) AS previous_month_revenue,
    (SUM(revenue) - LAG(SUM(revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date))) / 
    NULLIF(LAG(SUM(revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date)), 0) AS revenue_growth
FROM 
    store_sales
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) IN (2023, 2024)
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date)
ORDER BY 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date)

results.label: Aggregation
results.question: which payment method is most popular among premium segment customers
results.sql:
SELECT method, COUNT(*) as count FROM payments 
JOIN orders ON payments.order_id = orders.id 
JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id 
JOIN customer_segments ON customers.segment_id = customer_segments.id 
WHERE customer_segments.segment_name = 'Premium' 
GROUP BY method 
ORDER BY count DESC 
LIMIT 10

results.label: Aggregation
results.question: show products with high return rate
results.sql:
SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity, COUNT(oi.id) as total_orders, SUM(oi.quantity) / COUNT(oi.id) as return_rate 
FROM order_items oi 
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id 
GROUP BY p.name 
ORDER BY return_rate DESC 
LIMIT 10

results.label: Aggregation
results.question: what percentage of orders were cancelled by region
results.sql:
SELECT 
    o.channel, 
    COUNT(o.id) AS total_orders, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders, 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.id), 2) AS percentage_cancelled
FROM 
    orders o
GROUP BY 
    o.channel
ORDER BY 
    percentage_cancelled DESC
LIMIT 10
